threads.title: Whatever the switch opened and what screams
threads.detail: Llyr found a hidden switch behind Shar's statue; a grating sound opened something to the right with inhuman screaming.

threads.title: The zombie teen and the low-voiced thing in the chasm
threads.detail: The teen, risen from the boy's corpse, grew five heads and survived the fall, screaming. Something low-voiced is down there with him.

threads.title: Disarming the obelisk trap
threads.detail: The jet-black obelisks electrify anything passing between them. Catches under each can move, but nobody knows how to turn them off. Sykth is working on it.

threads.title: Massatar and the Sanguine Vessel
threads.detail: The dwarf keeper and the Sanguine Vessel are still missing. Garstang's audience depends on finding them under the deal with the Baldur's Gate official.

threads.title: Shar worship and Metheran's phylactery
threads.detail: The house's owner worshipped Shar, as does Metheran the lich. Is there a link to the phylactery the party is hunting?
